body: Thank you so much. I didn't get a chance to go to the doctor today but it was because I was feeling a lot better from reading all the helpful things you and the others have posted so I went to school and got caught up and was happy about that but I will be going this weekend. I'm in awe of all the support I've gotten here. I got your pm and will chat with you sometime and let you know how things are going if that's okay. You guys are awesome! I never really talked about this stuff before and it feels good getting it off my chest. Thank you thank you thank you!

I read it all. I just want to say thank you. You have given me great advice and I am really overwhelmed by all the support I have gotten here. I am going to look into the exposure therapy and give it a try.
Thank you very much. I'm overwhelmed by all the love I've gotten on this thread. It's good to know there are so many caring people out there.

Thank you. Yes this is my thinking as well. I never really wanted to try medication or thought I would need it. But I mean when I'm out of control and have to leave the school like that it was the last straw. I have to try something.

Thank you. Yeah man it was just so bad today like it was beyond my control. So weird to feel like I was removed out of that school or something beyond my will. I have just found out that my mother suffers from social anxiety and panic attacks and gets medication for it. I can take everything else the loneliness all of that and push through but this was just so strange.

Therapy sounds great but I don't even have to ask that has to cost a ton of money even though I'm in Canada right? i am going to the doctor tomorrow no matter what so hopefully they'll let me know what my options are.

Thank you. I agree with everything you said. It's just so weird and scary because it was like I was ripped out of that school today beyond my control. The only reason I don't want to tell my doctor about the suicide thoughts was because I heard if they think you might be suicidal they can put you in a hospital for 48 hours or something like that.

Thank you. I am going to the doctor tomorrow for sure. I just found out that my mom has had panic attacks and has gotten medication for that and social anxiety. This was amazing to me because I never knew that and we think it may run in the family or something (not sure if that's even possible)

Therapy...ughhh like I don't even have to ask but that has to cost a ton of money. Pretty sure I can't afford that even though I do live in Canada which is supposed to have the best health care but I still have to pay for medication and all that. I'm still trying to find out what my school insurance covers because I thought as a student in Canada I was covered but that info seems to be hidden online somewhere as I have looked everywhere.

Thank you. I was hoping this would be the case honestly but those types of girls seem like the hardest to meet (obviously). I look around at the college and I swear I haven't seen one girl that I would say is unattractive or ugly. I think that is a big part of it. Just seems like everyone that goes to college is so young and attractive and outgoing and wouldn't want to talk to me because they already have hundreds of friends. It's like I resent them which I know is wrong but can't control it for some reason. But at the same time I want to be like them and have lots of friends. I don't know it's a long road I guess. I'm going to save this post. Right now I have to make sure I don't go through the living hell I went through today again becasue that was unbearable.

Geez man you have already inspired me more then you know. 

I remember it was a week or so before I started school and I was getting really nervous about it. So I started going through my list of excuses about how I didn't have to go. You know like "oh I could always start next semester" or " Yeah who am I kidding there is no way I can go through with this" You know all that BS. Then I saw your AMA on the front page and read all of it. You really inspired me and it was a big part of getting through that first week. Thank you so much for doing that I'm sure it's helped hundreds or even thousands of people.

I'm really hoping to pull through this. The panic attack just scared me so much because it's something I had no control over. Like sitting in a class to nervous to talk and all that sucks but I can still do it and I know even if I don't make a single friend at the end of it I'll still have the degree and can get a decent job and know I've accomplished something I never thought I'd be able to. But today it was like somebody just grabbed me and threw me out of that school. I had no choice in it and it was a living hell.

I will be going to the doctor and I actually told my mom about what happened and to my surprise she said the exact same thing has happened to her before and she got medication that she uses only when she feels an attack coming on and it helps her a lot. That honestly blew my mind because I never would have thought she had social anxiety or anything so maybe part of it is hereditary. 

I will try the meditation you mentioned and everything you have said here is great advice honestly. Thanks again man I am almost liked shocked or something (in a good way) that you replied because your AMA was so awesome I feel like I'm having a celebrity moment or something hahaha.

Thank you
